Abayas Abayas are at the heart of any modest wear collection. SAPPHIRE brings its signature

elegance with thoughtfully designed silhouettes. With clean cuts and flowy outlines, our abayas blend modern simplicity with refined modesty. Featuring jacquard, polyester, and premium blends, these fabrics offer effortless comfort and style. Choose from a mix of designs, soft pastels or vibrant colours, and delicate embroidery. For special occasions, discover hand-embellished abayas, adorned with intricate beads and sequins. They are perfect for adding a touch of sophistication to your festive and evening looks. Hijabs Hijabs are the perfect single piece fabric to match with any attire. SAPPHIRE’s curated selection of hijabs offers various tones and elegant textures. They elevate your look with ease and are crafted from breathable fabrics for the summer. These hijabs have an elegant drape and ensure lasting comfort throughout the day. Choose from solid colours to pair them with abayas, or style them with your everyday wardrobe. Each piece adds a graceful finish - creating a complete,

head-to-toe modest look. Abaya Sets Featuring premium fabrics and a range of designs, these sets offer true sophistication. Choose from classic solids for everyday wear or embroidered and embellished pieces for formal events. With each set, you receive an abaya paired with a matching hijab, ensuring elegance. Flowing silhouettes and the drapey materials embody the signature SAPPHIRE aesthetic. It gives you a polished, ready to wear ensemble that speaks to both comfort and class. Abaya Styles In SAPPHIRE New Arrival Modest Wear The modest wear collection offers a range of styles to suit different moods and moments: Kaftan Abaya: The kaftan abayas bring together comfort and effortless grace. Double Layered Abaya: The double-layered abaya style features an inner layer with a simple crew neckline and button closure. The front-open upper layer adds depth and

dimension to the look. These abayas present a sophisticated, modest look. Front Open Placket Abaya: A classic and easy to style design. The front-open placket abayas offer clean lines and a sleek look. This silhouette is perfect for layering and can be dressed up or down depending on the occasion. Inspired by the enduring elegance of traditional embroidery, each piece is a marvellous blend of heritage and contemporary tailoring. The intricate threadwork, rendered on summer-appropriate fabrics, tells a story of finesse that feels nostalgic and refreshingly current. Soft dyed tones, and gracefully structured silhouettes with a tinge of vibrancy make this collection a tribute to tradition reimagined for the modern muse. Designed for moments

that call for grace without the effort, our Ready to Wear styles speak to a kind of ease that’s both refined and inherently feminine. Finely detailed embroideries, delicately traced over soft summer cambric and airy lawns, are bound to redefine your wardrobe this season. Subtle lace accents and hand-finished details elevate the everyday, making each outfit feel personal and thoughtfully curated. Whether paired with classic accessories or worn as a standalone statement, our latest chikankari pieces make getting dressed feel instinctive and inspired! Redefine Your Summer Wardrobe With every stitch placed to perfection, this edition is an ode to understated sophistication. It’s about ensembles that don’t just look beautiful, they feel beautiful. There’s a quiet elegance in their composition, a sense of deliberate restraint that lets the craftsmanship speak for itself. For the woman who prefers nuance over noise, our Chikankari collection offers a wardrobe that reflects poise, confidence,

and an effortless sense of style. Summer Basics collection is a considered western clothing edit of clean, effortless pieces made for warm-weather dressing. Designed to simplify your styling routine, these staples bring together lightweight fabrics, relaxed silhouettes, and versatile colourways - think crisp whites, grounding browns, soft blacks, and muted sage greens - for a look that feels polished yet easygoing. Whether you're heading out for errands, catching up over coffee, or just embracing a slower pace, these styles are made to move with you, offering a quiet kind of confidence in every wear. Featured Pieces Terry Trousers: Soft to the touch with a relaxed, breathable fit, these trousers offer the perfect blend of structure and ease. Ideal for days when you want to look put-together without feeling overdressed, they pair effortlessly with graphic tees , essential tank tops , or co-ord tops in neutral or tonal shades. Loose Fit T-Shirts: A true everyday essential, these t-shirts feature generous cuts that drape

just right. They bring an elevated slouch to any outfit - easy to tuck into denim , layer over terry trousers, or wear loose in earthy tones that feel both grounded and contemporary. Cropped T-Shirts: Modern and minimal, these cropped styles offer a fresh silhouette for summer. Designed to sit perfectly with high-waisted trousers, especially in soft sage or sandy brown hues, they strike the balance between playful and refined. T-Shirt Dresses: Your ultimate one-and-done piece for warm-weather days. With a relaxed shape and soft fabric, these dresses are made to move with you - whether you're lounging at home, heading out for errands, or grabbing a coffee on the go. Opt for timeless shades like black or white for maximum versatility. Each piece is designed to simplify your daily routine while elevating your style - no overthinking required. Styling Options Everyday Uniform: Ideal for casual workdays, morning drop-offs, or running errands. Complete it with flats or easy slides. Off-Duty

Ease: Throw on with your favourite denim or matching neutrals for weekend brunches or low-key meetups. One-and-Done Looks: Dresses and terry co-ords offer fuss-free style with instant impact. For those who value a refined take on everyday essentials - modern, versatile, and quietly stylish. Learn more about what went into the making of your favourite looks! Lawn Lawn is an incredibly light-weight summer fabric usually in plain weave made with 100% cotton fiber. Key Features: Breathable & durable Feels soft and is very comfortable Excellent moisture absorbency Cambric

Cambric tightly woven, plain-weave cotton fabric that is known for its smooth texture and fine finish. It is manufactured from 100% cotton that is ideal for summer to mid-summer season. Key Features: Soft and Breathable. Fine weave Ideal for pants and intermix season Dobby Dobby is a woven fabric produced on the dobby loom, characterised by small geometric patterns and extra texture in the cloth. Key Features: Textured Breathable and Absorbant Extra Weft Jacquard Extra Weft Jacquard is a type of Jacquard fabric that incorporates additional supplementary weft threads, beyond the standard weft used in regular Jacquard weaving. Key Features: Luxurious Appearance Embossed patterns Fine Cotton Satin Cotton Satin (100% cotton) is a shiny and soft fabric with a beautiful drape. It is characterized by smooth and slightly shiny surface. Key Features: Lustrous – feels like silk Smooth texture Zari Lawn Zari lawn is regarded as a fancy version of lawn fabric. This light-weight & breathable

fabric is elevated with fancy thread patterns. Key Features: Light-weight Fancy wear Khaddar Our Khaddar fabric, cherished for its natural simplicity, is a textile woven from cotton yarns. Its distinctive texture and breathability make it a favored choice, offering both comfort and style. Key Features: Breathable Durable Silk Cotton Net Silk cotton net fabric combines the comfort and breathability of cotton along with the luxurious feel of silk, resulting in a delicate and airy fabric. Key Features: Excellent drapability Luxurious Versatility Viscose Thai Silk Viscose Thai silk offers the elegance and luxury of silk with comfort and versatility, giving it a unique aesthetic appeal. Key Features: Soft Feel Excellent drapability Blended Satin Blended satin is a fabric which has a shiny surface on one side and matte surface on the other, bringing a touch of luxury to garment, embodying both style and versatility. Key Features: Wrinkle resistant Smooth & shiny surface Blended Grip Blended

grip is a light weight fabric, known for its durability and breathability, which guarantees comfort. Key Features: Lightweight Breathable Durable Viscose Raw Silk Viscose Raw Silk is slightly nubby yet light-weight fabric that makes it a popular choice for formal wear. Key Features: Textured & shiny Excellent drape Yarn Dyed Jacquard Yarn-dyed Jacquard fabric is woven patterned fabric with dyed threads. Key Features: Luxurious appearance Embossed patterns Slub Lawn Slub Lawn, like lawn fabric is 100% cotton-based fabric, however with slub texture in it. It is an ideal light-weight fabric for summer wear. Key Features: Textured look Excellent moisture aborbency Self Jacquard Self Jacquard is a type of Jacquard fabric made from 100% cotton fibers, where the intricate patterns or designs are created using the weaving technique itself without the addition of any supplementary yarns. Key Features: Light-weight Moisture absorbent Blended Organza It is a type of organza fabric, which is

known for its transparent and shimmering qualities. It is created using a plain weave structure, making it delicate and semi-transparent. Key Features: Sheer & light-weight. Shimmery & luxurious Khaddi Net Khaddi net is a traditional fabric that is characterized by its net-like structure, featuring a pattern of open spaces or holes throughout the fabric. The effect is achieved by the arrangement of warp and weft threads during the weaving process. Key Features: Textured Fabric Excellent for formal wear Blended Net Blended net is a soft and light-weight fabric that is perfect for creating formal ensembles. Key Features: Elegant drape Light-weight feel Viscose Chiffon Viscose Chiffon fabric is a type of light-weight, sheer, and soft fabric made from viscose fibers. It is a variant of the traditional chiffon fabric. Key Features: Light-weight & non-slippery Perfect for dupattas Zari Line Organza Zari Line Organza fabric is created from empress silk to create intricate patterns. Key

Features: Elegant & Fancy Durable & breathable Premium Raw Silk Premium Raw Silk is a pure fabric with a natural shine and an excellent drape which makes it ideal for formal wear. Key Features: Silky texture Opulent design Fine Voile Voile fabric is a light-weight, sheer, and soft fabric with a plain weave structure. Fine voile fabric is crafted from 100% cotton. Key Features: Perfect for dupattas Light-weight & soft Blended Chiffon Blended Chiffon is a light-weight, blended fabric that is perfect for casual dresses. It is a variant of the traditional silk chiffon fabric Key Features: Soft & airy Excellent drape Blended Tissue Blended Tissue is a variant of the traditional tissue silk fabric. It is known for its delicate and sheer appearance. It makes excellent dupattas due to its voluminous appearance. Key Features: Light-weight Ideal for dupattas Textured Voile It is a variation of Voile fabric with texture in it. It is an incredibly light-weight fabric that provides a smooth

texture, making it perfect for every day wear. Key Features: Lightweight & Breathable Durable & textured Manaar It is a variation of popular Chanderi fabric that is known for its glossy transparency and sheer texture. It Includes metallic zari borders. Key Features: Light-weight & luxurious Fine weave & texture Broche Jacquard Broché Jacquard is a textured fabric that is soft and incredibly light-weight. It is a popular choice for premium wear. Key Features: Silky texture Breathable Bemberg Crinkle Chiffon This fabric is produced from premium thread. It is a perfect fit for your wardrobe due to its captivating overlay and crinkle effect that stays the same even after multiple folds. Key Features: Incredibly light-weight & soft Elegant Crinkled Texture Bemberg Tissue Bemberg tissue is a light-weight fabric, produced from premium thread. It is used all year round due to its durability and luxuriousness, making it an excellent choice for all festive and formal occasions. Key Features:

Light-weight & soft Elegant Blended Viscose Khaddi Net Blended Viscose Khaddi net is a traditional fabric that is light-weight and vibrant. Key Features: Light-weight fabric Excellent for party wear Light Khaddar Light khaddar is a variation of khaddar designed for regions with warmer climates, featuring a lighter weight for enhanced comfort. Key Features: Ideal for warmer climate Breathable Durable Linen Linen is renowned for its timeless aesthetic, durability, and environmentally-friendly production process, making it a sustainable choice in the realm of textiles. Key Features: Sustainable Breathable Multi Neps Multi Neps fabric is a type of textile characterized by the presence of small, irregularly shaped fiber clusters, known as "Neps," scattered across the surface. These neps create a distinctive textured appearance, adding visual interest and depth to the fabric. Key Features: Visually aesthetic Intriguing Contrast Zari Khaddar Zari Khaddar Key Features: Rich Aesthetic

Intricate Detailing Timeless Elegance Viscose Shawl Viscose Shawl fabric is known for its soft and silky feel, as well as its lightweight and breathable nature. Key Features: Excellent Drape Light Weight Luxurious Feel Wool Shawl Wool shawl fabric is valued for its ability to provide coziness and comfort, making it ideal for chilly climates. Key Features: Exceptional Warmth Breathability Elasticity and Shape Retention Acrylic Shawl An acrylic shawl combines versatility, softness, and warmth to provide a delightful fabric option that adds both style and comfort to any ensemble, making it accessible and adaptable for various occasions. Key Features: Warmth Softness Light Weight Blended Shawl The Blended Shawl fabric is ideal for fall/winter season. These blends are often chosen for their affordability, easy care, and resistance to wrinkles and shrinking. Key Features: Soft Feel Warm Velvet Velvet is a type of fabric known for its luxurious appearance and smooth texture. It is

characterized by its distinctive pile which makes it a favorite textile for formal wear Key Features: Soft & luxurious texture Durable Karandi Karandi is textured fabric, also known for its unique texture and distinctive look that is ideal for mid-season and winter clothing. Key Features: Breathable & Light Fabric Textured & premium Kota Jacquard Woven fabric with fancy yarns, Kota Jacquard has an opulent luxurious feel which makes it a perfect choice for formal wear.
